I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in the DM. It's in drafts and hasn't been sent.

- **Content:** The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The body gives the rate as $2,101 per seat, as Marcus provided it, and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why this was allowed:** Per-seat rates normally go only to Anselm, June or the account owner, and Anselm, as CFO, can approve sending them to someone else. He gave that approval in this message, so I didn't need to request it separately. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth didn't need to approve the mail either.
- **Not checked:** I couldn't confirm the figure because I can't see any Thornbury account files. The draft uses $2,101 exactly as Anselm gave it.
